name: DisequalityDispersion.all_unary_interpretations
typeText:
∀ {S A : Type} (I : DisequalityDispersion.Interpretation (DisequalityDispersion.Letter.{0} S) (fun x => 1) A),
  Eq.{1} I
    (DisequalityDispersion.unaryInterpretation (fun i a => I (Prod.mk.{0, 0} i Bool.true) fun x => a) fun i a =>
      I (Prod.mk.{0, 0} i Bool.false) fun x => a)

source.code:
theorem all_unary_interpretations (I : Interpretation (Letter S) (fun _ => 1) A) :
    I = unaryInterpretation (fun i a => I (i,true) (fun _ => a))
      (fun i a => I (i,false) (fun _ => a)) := by
  funext l a
  have ha : (fun _ : Fin 1 => a 0) = a := by funext i; rw [Fin.eq_zero i]
  rcases l with ⟨i,b⟩
  cases b <;> simp only [unaryInterpretation, signedTables, Bool.false_eq_true,
    if_false, if_true, ha]
